summary: Kimberly-Clark priced a $4.9 billion five-tranche private Rule 144A/Reg S senior unsecured note offering (5.100% 2028, 5.300% 2029, 5.450% 2031, 5.650% 2034, 5.800% 2036), expected to settle about October 29, 2026, to fund the cash consideration for its previously announced acquisition of Kenvue Inc., targeted for Q4 2026. The notes carry a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the deal does not close by five business days after the later of May 31, 2027 or an agreed outside date. Kimberly-Clark separately launched exchange offers for Kenvue notes on September 28, 2026. Watch financing conditions and outside-date risk.
